action.objective: Play g3 with verified safety, improving the pawn structure and offering a trade of the h4 bishop.
action.rationale: g2g3 is the only commit_ready move with exact evidence at depth 4 (score +8) and a complete safety probe: no immediate mate and no tactical refutation found. It attacks the h4 bishop and creates luft, while the broad search at depth 3 favored the same move. No stronger exact alternative exists in the completed analyses.
